concepts.def: Low monoamines like serotonin cause depression.
Negative views of self, world and future.
Vulnerability plus stress triggers a disorder.
Probability twins share a trait or disorder.

walkthroughs.body_html: The monoamine theory suggests depression is caused by low serotonin (and sometimes noradrenaline). Twin studies show higher concordance in identical twins, supporting a genetic vulnerability. SSRIs treat depression by raising serotonin levels.
Beck argued depressed people hold negative views of the self ('I am worthless'), the world ('nothing works') and the future ('it won't get better'). Cognitive distortions maintain this triad.

Biological theories explain why medication works and why depression runs in families. Cognitive theories explain why CBT is effective. Most psychologists now favour a diathesis-stress view: biological vulnerability plus stressful life events.
